feedback: PLAN REVIEW: reject the fortified/walled settlement, 40–50 tiny people, a claimed remainder of 20–25 people, ceasefire perimeter/barrier, figures disappearing off canvas, and sub-30px labels. None of those facts/outcomes is supported. REPLACE with one conceptual ordinary building/city silhouette in x64..300,y100..300 (not a fortress or accurate location). A small group of LARGE 55–70px human figures moves from the building entrance toward open space x330..620,y220..320, in a coordinated staggered evacuation; the few figures are representative, not a literal count or fraction. Keep every figure inside the safe area; use clean fades rather than exiting screen. No leftover-population inference. Layer people intentionally in front of doorway, never across text. One label box x64..656,y342..386, centered 32px: initially 'Temporary ceasefire', replace with 'Until Sunday evening' at second beat; never both simultaneously. The building should be a recognizable carefully drawn substantial silhouette, people have matching consistent proportions. Use the full width with a balanced central drawing. No ornamental border, bird, broker portraits, map, vehicles/counts or extra subplots. Timings are normalized fractions, not literal seconds. The movement should explain evacuation, not simply fade whole icons. This review overrides conflicting storyboard details.

At most two labels: 'Not disclosed' in x64..290,y70..105 and 'Public announcement' in x395..660,y70..105, explicitly wrapped if needed; remove both before the final single 'Ethics inquiry ordered' in x80..640,y340..386. No title/duplicate paragraph, no arbitrary dates. All objects stay inside 32px safe edges throughout; never hide drawing behind labels. Use coordinated disclosure/reveal motion and a clean final state. Treat this review as an override of conflicting storyboard geometry.
